rationale: The held 7 FR 7419 text confirms the identity: EO 9248 (1942-09-17) has one paragraph, which rewrites Section V of EO 9240. The held 10 FR 10275 text of EO 9601 revokes 'Executive Order No. 9240, as amended', effective as of its date, 1945-08-21, with no savings clause, so the substituted Section V ended on that date. A held-text number search found only the order itself, and the 1945 amendments by EO 9597-9600 touch Section IB, not Section V. The basis is the acting text, not the editorial notes, and the disclosed gaps are accurate.
